run_load_test_router: run a load test sending 500 concurrent async completion requests through a litellm Router
create_router_with_models: create a litellm Router configured with OpenAI and Azure model providers and retry settings
test_async_completion_with_semaphore: test async completion calls using a semaphore to limit concurrency to 100 simultaneous requests
measure_response_latency: measure total and average response time across 500 concurrent LLM completion requests
handle_timeout_exceptions: handle litellm Timeout exceptions when async completion requests exceed the configured timeout
